delta.comment: 029-DL complete. Expansive DAG-as-steering deliberation widening 028-DL. Verdict: operator pushback correct; 028-DL re-scoped (not overturned) from a general verdict on DAGs to a correct verdict about open-node-set convergence graphs. Key results: (1) six determinism properties disambiguated - a DAG delivers choice-elimination, coverage/reachability and auditability outright over CLOSED node sets, cannot deliver termination or memoization, and delivers reproducibility only inside the hermetic installer; 028-DL tested only termination, the one property DAGs cannot deliver. (2) report-only != non-steering: compute_next_eligible already steers by total-order choice elimination without any scheduler, so the dag-readiness no-scheduler NON-GOAL is respected, not revisited. (3) Empirical: 452 task-to-task blocks edges have NO reader; the shipment graph that does have a reader carries 26 edges across 149 shipments (critical path = 2 nodes); 84% of shipment ordering is undeclared, forcing _prior_shipment_id's numeric-adjacency heuristic which has produced two recorded correctness defects. Prototype found 44 real findings (9 malformed edges, 3 orphan tasks, 11 uncovered tasks, 21 undeclared shipment orderings, 0 cycles). Architecture: one node namespace (UAR), several typed edge families, two laws - DERIVE-NEVER-PERSIST (dissolves 028-DL's disposable-cache objection; zero backlogit change) and NO-GRAPH-WITHOUT-A-READER (makes the F5 written-but-unread failure mechanically detectable). Pruned as cargo-cult: quality-gate DAG, policy-interaction DAG, memoization DAG. Recommended first slice: read-only report-only `autoharness gate backlog-graph-integrity`, zero new authority, with a pre-registered prospective falsification test. NO harvest, NO shipment - by choice: Q1's architectural laws want operator ratification before code assumes them. Artifact: docs/decisions/2026-08-25-dag-as-steering-mechanism-determinism-opportunity-map.md

PUSHBACK ROUND 1 (Orchestrator adversarial review) — addendum appended to the decision artifact. FIVE positions adopted, ONE adopted with a material precision, ONE refuted with data, and the #1 recommendation REVERSED on measurement. (A0) Q1 ratify-the-laws WITHDRAWN as a gate — it was manufactured; both laws are reversible defaults for a report-only slice that persists nothing. (A1) Termination transfer CONFIRMED with precision: acyclicity+finiteness gives termination of the TRAVERSAL not the WORK — 028-DL's non-termination lives INSIDE a node, so the DAG bounds the outer loop and the monotone measure bounds the inner loop; the two results COMPOSE. Closed/open partition delivered: NINE closed surfaces vs FOUR open. Bonus: P-021 is a closed-world-PRESERVATION policy (C2 defers new work to the stash so the executing node set stays fixed). (A2) Steering-not-scheduling ADOPTED with a stronger precedent than claimed: pipeline-topology is ALREADY a fail-closed gate over the shipment dependency graph, so graph enforcement is the current production state, not an unprecedented category. (A3) Enforcement CONFRONTED with an AUTHORITY TEST: a gate is authority-expanding iff it creates an obligation not already in policy; mechanically checking an existing obligation is the REMOVAL of unreliable enforcement, not expansion. Smallest safe enforced gate = fail-closed structural validation of Stage's OWN harvest output at creation time (P-003 already obliges it) — needs NO operator consent. (A4) Tie-break hypothesis REFUTED with data, and it FALSIFIES THIS DOCUMENT'S OWN #1: order determinacy is 0.34% under declared edges and 0.55% with the C13 lift, while the numeric-ID convention totally orders 100% of the 11,026 shipment pairs and has NEVER been contradicted (0/63 cross-shipment edges). Tie-breaks are not missing — they already do ~100% of the work. C13's D2/choice-elimination credit WITHDRAWN; it survives only as a bug fix (retire _prior_shipment_id's adjacency heuristic, NOT the numeric convention). (A5a) Coverage-as-reachability ADOPTED and promoted. (A5b) Memoization strong form STAYS PRUNED; weak form CONCEDED and promoted to first-class — input-hash staleness is what makes coverage proofs DURABLE rather than momentary. (A6) CENTRAL THESIS CONFIRMED on four evidences, the fourth being a controlled NATURAL EXPERIMENT inside one repo: closure artifacts (which HAVE a mechanical reader in pipeline-topology) went 0%->100% adoption, while the acceptance-criteria block (which has NO reader) rose to 46% and COLLAPSED TO 0%. Also: the supervisor phase machine is coded and journaled while the agent Required Steps graph is prose-only; P-005 exists solely to punish skipped steps, which is a standing admission the sequence is unreliably re-derived; checkpoint `phase` holds 27 distinct ad-hoc values. Law 2 (no graph without a reader) is therefore not hygiene — it is the load-bearing empirical finding, and level-(a) emitted-but-unread graphs are NEGATIVE value because they decay silently while projecting rigor. (A7) THE PUSHBACK'S CANDIDATE WINS: coverage beats ordering — 73% of tasks (446/612) have no acceptance-criteria block and the convention is decaying, versus ordering which is already 100% determined and never observed wrong. Two corrections: AC-criterion-granularity coverage is NOT computable today (only 4/612 tasks carry numbered ACn IDs, so it needs plan-unit identity from C1 first), but leaf-to-evidence reachability IS computable (closure evidence refs carry task IDs and commit SHAs that resolve 3/3 and 2/2). (A7.1) NEW candidate sharper than either: CONVENTION-DECAY DETECTOR — flag any structured convention whose adoption trend is declining. It is Law 2 made mechanical, self-applying (tells you which reader to build next), fully retrospective, zero authority, and would have caught the AC collapse four bands early. REVISED FIRST SLICE: read-only report-only `autoharness gate coverage-integrity`. Falsification strengthened to something genuinely refutable: Law 2 falsified if a declining convention HAS a reader or a readerless convention is stable/rising across 4+ bands; coverage thesis falsified if the 446 criterion-less tasks show no higher review-finding rate than the 166 with criteria. READY FOR IMPL-PLAN NOW against A7.2, no ratification precondition.

PUSHBACK ROUND 2 — round-1 #1 WITHDRAWN on new measurement. (B1) Law 2 as stated is REFUTED. The round-1 natural experiment was confounded exactly as challenged (reader vs reader-with-teeth collinear at n=2), so I found the separating cell: gate size self-describes in cli.py L516-519 as "advisory and must never block", and shipment `dependencies:` is read by the BLOCKING pipeline-topology gate but _prior_shipment_id (topology.py L1433-1465) SILENTLY FALLS BACK to numeric adjacency when the field is absent. That yields a paired comparison with the confound removed — SAME GATE, same corpus, same period, same authors, introduced in the same band, differing ONLY in whether absence is penalized: closure artifact (absence BLOCKS) 0/0/0/9/68/91/100%; shipment dependencies (absence SILENTLY COMPENSATED) 0/0/0/0/18/59/41%. Mature bands 117-S+ n=39: closure 37/39 vs deps 20/39, Fisher exact two-sided p=1.97e-05. Readership is NOT the variable. (B1.1) But the corrected law has TWO durable mechanisms, not one, and gate size is the counterexample to a pure teeth reading: advisory, fail-open, explicitly forbidden from blocking, yet size/complexity sit at 100% BECAUSE sizing.py L343 WRITES the field itself. LAW 2 (CORRECTED): a convention survives iff a machine either PRODUCES it or PENALIZES ITS ABSENCE; being read is neither necessary nor sufficient. Four measured cells: produced (size 0->48->100->100%), penalized (closure ->100%), read-but-tolerated (deps 59->41%), unread (AC block 62->15%). Generation is as durable as enforcement and needs NO CONSENT — that is the escape route the teeth framing cannot see. Caveat: size/complexity are young (band 4+, ~3 bands), and the AC block also looked healthy at 62% before collapsing. (B1.2) CONSEQUENCE: the round-1 slice `coverage-integrity` is report-only = cell 3 = the cell that decayed, so it would have rotted. WITHDRAWN. The escape is not teeth: a report-only gate rots when it depends on authors maintaining a PER-ARTIFACT convention; a gate that reads only already-existing data and is consumed at a decision point has no per-artifact convention to decay. (B2) ADOPTED: authority test v2 = obligation novelty OR activation blast radius. Migration story solved by the data — the phase-2 harvest-output gate validates Stage's OWN output at creation time, so it only ever sees post-activation items and is INTRINSICALLY enforce-on-new-only: day-one blast radius against the 612 existing tasks is exactly ZERO with no grandfathering clause needed. Sequencing: generate -> warn on new -> block only at sustained >=90% new-item adoption over >=2 bands. (B3) CONCEDED, falsifier NOT COMPUTABLE: copilot_review.py works on PR-level reviewThreads storing thread IDs + isResolved (L81, L297-314); there is NO per-task attribution of review findings anywhere in the corpus. Replaced with a fully local controlled test — unit=shipment, predictor=fraction of tasks with AC block, outcome=docs/compound records (76, named by shipment ID), controls=task count and size, stratum=117-S+. Computed over 58 mature shipments: AC-rich n=20 mean 5.2 tasks 0.20 records vs AC-poor n=38 mean 4.7 tasks 0.18 records. NULL, and underpowered (base rate 0.2). So the coverage thesis has NO supporting outcome evidence and the best available local test cannot supply any — a second independent demotion on top of B1.2. (B4) NEW #1 = `autoharness gate convention-durability`: classify every structured convention into the four durability cells and PREDICT decay. §4b answered concretely — the enumeration is DERIVED not curated: 48 distinct frontmatter keys + 18 distinct delimited body blocks = 66 conventions, mechanically decidable, zero judgment calls, nobody owns the list because it is computed. The long tail is the payload: it already surfaces an unnamed SCHISM (`acceptance_criteria` frontmatter key on 3 artifacts coexisting with `acceptance-criteria` body block on 169 — two encodings of one concept drifting apart) and two dead-on-arrival conventions (queue_position 1/149, covering_feature_id 1/149). It escapes its own law because it maintains no per-artifact convention. It is a predictive instrument that ALREADY MADE A CORRECT PREDICTION (deps decays, closure converges — observed at p=2e-5 before the classifier existed). Falsifier: refuted if any produced/penalized convention decays over >=2 bands, or any unread/tolerated one is stable or rising over >=4 bands — both computable today. Authority: NONE. (B4 #2) AC-ID GENERATOR not reporter, gated on #1: gate size's shape applied to criteria (advisory, fail-open, writes back stable ACn IDs to the 169 existing delimited blocks), moving coverage from cell 3 to cell 1. §4a conceded flatly — slice 1 could never have performed its flagship check and I let it inherit unearned rhetorical weight. (B5) P-021 reframe: ONE narrow operational consequence (a coverage proof must be computed after C2 capture has run, else the node set is still open and the proof is void); otherwise labelled INSIGHT, not architecture, and must not accrete further weight. Two rounds, two of my own #1s withdrawn on measurement.

PUSHBACK ROUND 3 (final) — artifact RETITLED, scope-drift answered, gate BLOCKED with named criteria. (C1) Drift charge partly CONCEDED: #1 and #2 are not DAGs and do not steer. HEADLINE FINDING stated plainly: the DAG is not the lever; the lever is whether a machine PRODUCES the artifact or PENALIZES ITS ABSENCE. But the DAG question is ANSWERED, not abandoned or superseded — the durability law and the DAG question are ORTHOGONAL axes (the law governs whether a representation PERSISTS; a DAG governs what you can PROVE once it exists), so the law is a FILTER on which graphs can exist, never a replacement. Applying the filter to the nine closed surfaces: SEVEN SURVIVE (shipment manifest items 149/149 machine-written; decomposition parent_id 630 machine-set; gate set; policy set; file cross-reference graph; pack/layer composition with a single-file-config caveat; Required Steps conditional on a generator for the 27-value free-string phase cursor) and TWO DIE (impl-plan units R# 18/71, acceptance criteria ACn 4/612) — precisely the two requiring authors to mint NEW identifiers, and no others. (C1.3) I tested a DAG-shaped challenger against my non-DAG #1 rather than arguing it: the cross-reference integrity graph (C6) passes every filter, so I measured its defect rate — 400 markdown links, 343 local, 4 dangling (1.2%) and ALL FOUR are documentation placeholders (url, path, ../instructions/foo.md in template docs). REAL DEFECT RATE 0%. The 131 unresolved backlog `references:` entries are historical link rot on archived artifacts (templates/agents/ship.agent.md.tmpl -> _ship.agent.md.tmpl rename), not live failures. A gate with a 0% defect rate is ceremony: C6 PRUNED ON MEASUREMENT. (C2) Produced cell split — n is not 1 but the sub-cell #2 needs IS: STORE-PRODUCED (backlogit writes them: id/artifact_type/created_at/updated_at/status/title 956/956, items 149/149, parent_id 630, commit 553, archived_from 559, source_stash_*) has n~10 across the FULL 4-month corpus with ZERO observed decay; GATE-PRODUCED (external advisory gate writes back) has exactly ONE member, `size`, ~3 bands old. So #2 is a bet on a pattern replicated ONCE inside a mechanism class replicated ~10 times. ADOPTED: #1 is now a FORMAL PREREQUISITE for #2 and must emit produced-cell membership split by store- vs gate-produced. (C3) ADOPTED without reservation: the underpowered null is downgraded to "no supporting evidence found," NOT evidence of absence, and is NO LONGER counted as a second independent demotion — coverage is demoted on B1.2 cell placement alone. (C4) STAGE GATE VERDICT: BLOCKED, three measured criteria. (1) Slice 1a (adoption-trend detector over the 66 conventions) is fully mechanical and READY IN SUBSTANCE, but slice 1b (the cell classifier) is BLOCKED — I tested whether the convention->mechanism map is mechanically derivable and THE PROXY FAILS: archived_from (559 artifacts, unambiguously machine-written) has ZERO references in autoharness source, as do priority (761) and complexity (186), BECAUSE THE PRODUCER LIVES IN A DIFFERENT REPOSITORY (backlogit). The hand-maintained alternative is a per-artifact convention with no producer and no penalty = cell 4 = decays by its own law. (2) THE STEP-3 PLANNING GATE CANNOT BE EXECUTED HERE: .github/skills contains FOUR installed skills (install-harness, tune-harness, verify-harness, workspace-discovery) while templates/skills ships TWENTY-NINE including impl-plan, plan-harden, plan-review and harvest — autoharness ships the entire Stage planning gate chain to consumer workspaces and installs NONE of it for itself. I refused to hand-write a document and label it impl-plan output, because substituting prose for an absent mechanism is the exact failure this deliberation spent three rounds diagnosing. (3) #2 rests on the n=1 gate-produced pattern. Criterion 2 is a HARNESS GAP not a work-readiness gap; recommended unblock is installing impl-plan/plan-review/harvest into this workspace from the templates it already ships. ARTIFACT RETITLED to "Machine-Produced Structure, Not Graph Structure, Is the Binding Constraint on Determinism — with the DAG partition that survives", filename now docs/decisions/2026-08-25-machine-produced-structure-determinism-and-the-surviving-dag-partition.md, with a rewritten abstract and original_title/original_filename preserved in frontmatter. NO harvest, NO shipment — deliberation-only outcome, blocked on a named harness gap.
